geo.title: Get started
geo.body:
Equiangular means equilateral? Test, then prove.

Goal: I can prove the converse of the Isosceles Triangle Theorem and its corollaries.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Converse: if two angles of a triangle are equal, the sides opposite them are equal.

Proof: in triangle ABC with angle B = angle C, compare triangle ABC with triangle ACB (the same triangle, read in a different order). BC = CB, angle B = angle C and angle C = angle B, so the two are congruent by ASA. Then AB = AC by CPCTC.

Corollaries: an equilateral triangle is equiangular, and an equiangular triangle is equilateral.

slides.title: Check yourself
slides.reveal: Apply the Isosceles Triangle Theorem to each pair of equal sides: each pair of angles opposite them is equal, so all three angles are equal.
